capabilities: Import bookmarks from an XBEL file and convert them to a Markdown file
Configure XBEL source path and Markdown output path and filename
Keep a configurable number of backup files of generated bookmarks
Automatically update the Markdown file on a set interval
intentEvidence: This plugin is inspired by Floccus, a browser extension that synchronizes bookmarks across different browsers.
motivation: The README says the plugin is inspired by Floccus, a browser extension that synchronizes bookmarks across different browsers.
problem: Bookmarks saved in browsers via Floccus stay outside Obsidian, with no built-in way to turn an XBEL bookmark export into a Markdown note.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by Floccus, a browser extension that synchronizes bookmarks across different browsers.

requires.name: Floccus browser extension (or an XBEL bookmark file)

summary: Imports bookmarks from an XBEL file produced by Floccus and converts them into a Markdown file in the vault.
